clean_repro.observed: Container crash - Qdrant service stopped responding, curl returned exit code 52 (empty response)

violated_assumptions: API should validate parameter ranges before attempting collection creation
Extreme parameter values (shard_number=INT32_MAX, replication_factor=0) should be rejected with 4xx error
Service should remain stable when given invalid input parameters

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: CreateCollection operation → shard_number/replication_factor extraction → NonZeroU32::new() validation (only checks minimum > 0, no maximum upper bound) → Collection::new() with extreme values causes crash
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现: collection creation validation只检查了最小值 (NonZeroU32::new() 确保 > 0),但缺少最大值上限检查。shard_number=INT32_MAX 和 replication_factor=0 绕过了最小值检查,导致容器崩溃。这是真缺陷 — contract 要求 >= 1,源码只实现了最小值检查,没有防护极端值。

falsification.probe: Cannot falsify - Qdrant container actually crashed and stopped responding
falsification.observed: Container crashed during test, no falsification possible

excluded: Environment issue (reproducible on standard Docker setup)
Request parameter typo (values are clearly extreme but valid JSON)
API semantics misunderstanding (crash is clearly a bug)

cognition_match.developer_quote: Parameter validation on filter/condition APIs (min_should, value_count)
cognition_match.note: 缺陷命中 developer_cognition.json 中的 blind_spot_indicators: 'Parameter validation on filter/condition APIs' — 虽然这里是 collection 创建参数而非 filter,但属于同一类参数验证缺失问题。维护者明确将参数验证盲点列为关注领域。

verdicts.rationale: Qdrant 容器在接收极端参数值 (shard_number=2147483647, replication_factor=0) 时崩溃而非返回 4xx 错误。契约明文规定 shard_number >= 1 和 replication_factor >= 1,但源码仅通过 NonZeroU32::new() 检查最小值,完全缺失最大值上限验证。这不是 graceful degradation 或 by-design 行为,而是真正的资源耗尽导致的崩溃。命中开发者认知的参数验证盲点模式。
